text: Paper · ICLR 2021 · arXiv 2010.11929 An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale (ViT) Alexey Dosovitskiy, Lucas Beyer, Alexander Kolesnikov, Dirk Weissenborn, Xiaohua Zhai, Thomas Unterthiner, Mostafa Dehghani, Matthias Minderer, Georg Heigold, Sylvain Gelly, Jakob Uszkoreit, Neil Houlsby Google Research, Brain Team · October 2020 (arXiv v1 22 October 2020; v2 June 2021) In one line: Split images into 16x16 patches and feed them to a vanilla Transformer; pre-trained on 300M JFT images, ViT-H/14 beats BiT-L on every benchmark and edges Noisy Student on ImageNet (88.55 vs 88.5) with about 4x less pre-training compute, while CNNs still win on smaller pre-training sets: at scale, data outweighs convolutional inductive bias.
label: core

text: 88.55% ImageNet top-1 ViT-H/14 pre-trained on JFT-300M also 90.72% ReaL, 94.55% CIFAR-100, 77.63% VTAB · Table 2 2.5k TPUv3-core-days to pre-train ViT-H/14 against 9.9k for BiT-L and 12.3k for Noisy Student · Table 2 -1.4 to +3.0 points ViT-L/16 minus ViT-B/16 on ImageNet pre-trained on ImageNet, then on JFT-300M: the bigger model only wins with more data · Table 5 Verdict: Believe the architecture and the direction: a plain Transformer on patches, pre-trained on enough data, matches or beats the 2020 CNNs, and every later vision tower is built this way.

text: Problem §1 Introduction, §2 Related work By 2020 the Transformer was the default architecture in NLP, usually pre-trained on a large corpus and then fine-tuned, with models past 100B parameters and no sign of saturating ( §1 ).
label: core

text: Vision was still ruled by convolutional networks: ResNet-like models held the state of the art in large-scale image recognition ( §1 ).
label: core

text: Earlier attempts to bring self-attention to images either kept the CNN skeleton and added or swapped in attention blocks, or replaced convolutions with specialised attention patterns (local neighbourhoods, sparse approximations, blocks, one axis at a time) that "require complex engineering to be implemented efficiently on hardware accelerators" and so had not been scaled ( §2 ).
label: core

text: Plain global attention over pixels is quadratic in the pixel count: a 224 × 224 image is 50,176 pixels, about 2.5 billion pairs per layer and head.

text: Idea §3 Method Turn the image into a sequence of tokens and run a completely standard Transformer encoder on it. "In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible", so that scalable NLP architectures and their efficient implementations can be used almost out of the box ( §3 ).
